notes: FIX LOI 'Caption chua dat giong ke ngoi thu nhat' khi chon ngon ngu khac tieng Anh. Bo kiem tra caption truoc day CHI nhan dai tu tieng Anh (I/my/me/we/our) va dem do dai theo kieu tieng Anh, nen caption tieng Viet/Nhat/Han... LUON bi loai oan ca 2 lan roi tool bao loi va dung. Nay them FIRST_PERSON_MARKERS cho du 16 ngon ngu (toi/minh/em..., watashi/boku..., je/moi..., ich/mein...), ngon ngu khong dan cach (Nhat/Han/Thai) thi do do dai bang KY TU thay vi 'tu', va cau nhac viet lai CAPTION_REWRITE_NOTE cung dich theo ngon ngu (truoc day luon nhac bang tieng Anh). Khong doi gi khac: prompt giu NGUYEN noi dung, chi dich vai cau noi ve ngon ngu (do tuong dong 99,9%; 16460 -> 16474 ky tu, chi +14). Da test: caption tieng Viet qua duoc kiem tra (11 dai tu ngoi 1); caption tieng Anh van nhu cu; 16/16 ngon ngu co du markers + rewrite note + CTA.
